name: Niemornak
backstory: Child of Darnakus and Niemoran in Salthos Cruzados; raised alongside walks the transit route's Salthos stretch at dawn..., having heard about Salthos Mediator Line.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Had a child with Darika, named Darnarika.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Dornakus and Fenrius now have a child, Dornarius.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Fenserika and Niekus now have a child, Fenekus.
Grew up hearing: Learned that Darnus has died.
Had a child with Fenriukas, named Niemoruk.

criterion.standard: holds themself accountable to Gorff Ledger Crossing War, whatever it costs
criterion.wasted_life: one that never had to answer for Gorff Ledger Crossing War
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: takes his turn hearing petitions each morning, refers the harder disputes upward same as his father did, and checks the crossing's quiet himself before dark

arc.premise: Niemornak's taken an interest in the old Gorff Ledger Crossing War purely from the toll side - he wants to know whether the losses it claims were ever actually reflected in what the crossing charged afterward.
